label: preparing
what: Bread and related provisions for an innkeeper's community hospitality matter at the great hall. The mayor was told it required no preparation and that he would attend alone; the activity may be concealed from him, though the record does not establish his awareness of the preparations. The neighbour and secretary's involvement is not clearly shown as knowing assistance; the secretary's appointment note appears to reinforce the mayor's false impression, but could simply reflect information provided by the mayor/innkeeper.
